goal: Compare actual live search wall time, total CPU, peak private committed memory and sampled working-set memory for every one of the 86 public qBittorrent-style Rust/Python adapters. Complete the comparison and deliver per-source evidence, not merely process completion.
validated_method: scripts/benchmark-limetorrents.py Windows Job Object meter reused by scripts/benchmark-sources.py. Suspended creation assigns the CLI before resuming; accounts for CLI, Python children and owned conhost processes. Do not assume Rust has process_count=1. Three reporting-guard unit tests and a four-invocation live harness smoke passed. Smoke measurements are excluded from the real 516-invocation dataset.
when_running: Inspect state, exit marker, and the last few driver-log lines once. Verify the saved process if a stall is suspected. Retain the next heartbeat without restarting or repeatedly reporting unchanged state. Back off repeated unchanged checks.
when_succeeded: Pause automation-3 immediately once genuine waiting ends. Verify exactly 516 unique source/trial/backend records, all86 IDs x both backends x3 trials, same immutable executable/query/settings/pins, no measurement_failed records, positive CPU/private-memory counters, valid raw reports and CSV86 rows. Check process names/counts include Python on Python runs and no Python on native runs (owned conhost is normal). Review matched positive result-identity pairs; restrict speed/CPU/memory advantage conclusions to those pairs. Produce and deliver concise Arabic comparisons plus links to sources.csv and comparison.json; include all-source failure/empty/different-result coverage. State that live-network timing is not a pure parser/language benchmark and wall time includes fresh CLI startup. Inspect results before claiming superiority. Exclude Jackett configuration rows from true result counts.
when_failed_or_stalled: Pause the heartbeat once no operation is running. Read the precise error and per-measurement records; keep all completed measurements. Fix only benchmark instrumentation/reporting within scope, then resume with the canonical command and retain a heartbeat for genuine waiting. If individual measurement_failed records exist, preserve their records/raw output in an attempts folder before retrying only those keys; do not classify source failures/timeouts as instrumentation failures. Do not modify source adapters, VPN, user processes, or shipped packages during this comparison. A previously interrupted measurement may have created cache files; use a fresh per-attempt home/cache before retrying it.
completion_boundary: A running process, partial CSV, synthetic parity test, or one-source smoke does not complete the requested all-source comparison.
